items.title: Large worldOverhaul traffic and construction update.
items.summary:
Branches: Stable and Beta
Date: 2026-10-09 10:53 UTC
Versions: Infrastructure 0.3.1 · WorldOverhaul.dll 0.3.1.0

# WorldOverhaul patch notes 
• Fixed crashes during startup and when taking bug-report screenshots, including captures with an empty title or description. HQ60 / ZH01
  • Fixed incompatible rail branching and corrected warnings for head-to-head connections between different gauges. KU99 / VK04
  • Fixed footpath continuation across roads and managed footpath removal. KE99
  • Corrected Maglev bridge support height. RS98
  • Fixed building-loading issues involving malformed definitions, geometry generation, and cache validation. FC01
  • Fixed loading stalls at “initializing building types.” WU97
  • Fixed excessive memory usage and crashes while loading Workshop buildings. XP17
  • Corrected Maglev audio and missing sound-profile lookup. UZ06
  • Fixed TR09 orientation and access to train settings. SL25
  • Fixed blocked trolleybus routes and slow citizen walking.
  • Fixed construction offices failing to reach nearby construction sites.
  • Restored the building particle-size multiplier.
  • Restored default emergency audio for fire-ladder vehicles.
  • Corrected vehicle engine-power normalization.
  • Corrected single-horse energy consumption.
  • Fixed oversized vehicle $FAMILY strings exceeding the native buffer.
  • Fixed missing buttons in the Steam-not-running startup dialog. QK58
  • Fixed launcher updates blocking Play and reporting a missing WorldOverhaul DLL. AT72
## Traffic & vehicle behaviour

### Fixes
- Traffic queues loaded from a save no longer freeze. Before, 23 of 24 queued trucks stood still for 15 minutes after loading. [verified]
- Vehicles no longer get stuck for 15 minutes or more inside building yards, entrances and exits. These standoffs now clear after about 10 seconds. [verified]
- Vehicles no longer dip into the ground on raised building connectors. [verified]
- A vehicle whose road start was rejected no longer stays stuck in the yard and blocks the vehicle behind it. One case was a route from a building back into itself. [verified]
- Fixed junction gridlocks caused by vehicles holding a junction slot they could not use. Examples were vehicles waiting behind the junction's own queue and vehicles beside a stuck merging van. [verified]
- Vehicles re-routed during a drive no longer have the new route rejected at junctions with identical parallel lanes. [verified]
- Two-slot storages and garages now let two trucks in at once instead of one. [verified]
- Long trucks no longer stop with their rear end across a junction. They now wait until the whole vehicle fits on the road beyond. [untested]
- A vehicle that changes its route now gives up its junction booking for the old route. Before, cross traffic could wait forever, which looked like trucks out of fuel. [untested]
- Long trucks turning left against each other no longer deadlock at T-junctions on wide roads. Saves that are already locked this way are not untangled. [untested]
- A bus or other vehicle stranded for minutes after nearby road edits now recovers, and the queue behind it moves again. [untested]
- Cars waiting for a left-turn queue no longer stand in the through lane. Overtaking no longer pulls them out of the turn queue. [untested]
- Arriving trucks now wait on the road when a multi-bay building such as a customs house or storage is full, instead of blocking the entrance. [untested]
- Trailers now stay on their truck's hitch on lane changes and pull-outs. Before, they swung wide and drifted off the hitch. [untested]
- Traffic on the main road no longer brakes at merges and splits as if they were crossroads. [untested]
- When a lane change is unsafe at that moment, a moving vehicle no longer stops dead. It changes lanes a little further on. [untested]
- Vehicles on a priority road no longer slow almost to a stop at priority junctions. [untested]
- A truck merging from a ramp and a truck on the main lane no longer drive through each other. [tonight]
- A truck that is changing lanes now gives way instead of holding junction slots that another truck needs. A merging truck that has to stop behind main-road traffic now also gives up its slots for the junctions beyond the merge. At one roundabout, two queues had stood still for more than 9 minutes. At a cloverleaf, the truck in front of a stopped merging truck waited 3 minutes. [tonight]
- Vehicles plan their lane much further ahead. This should mean fewer late lane changes, less diagonal drifting and less hard braking near cloverleaf ramps. [tonight]
- A truck waiting at the start of a long merge, such as a loop ramp running beside the main road, now asks for its turn to merge. Before, it never asked and stood still until it was sent home after 10 minutes, and the whole loop backed up behind it. A vehicle that has to wait for a junction just after a short lane change no longer stops short of the lane change, where it could never ask for that junction. [tonight]
- Trucks at a building entrance that can be entered from either lane, such as a customs house, no longer lock each other when each is waiting to change into the other's lane just before the entrance. A truck that cannot make that lane change now drives in from the lane it is in. [tonight]
- With the new trailer hitch, trailers should also stay on the road at joints where the next road piece starts slightly behind the end of the previous one. Trucks now keep their heading through such joints. [tonight]

### Changes
- Trucks now accelerate according to their power-to-weight ratio instead of crawling at the game's minimum. Heavier trucks are still slower, horse carts are unchanged, and the values can be tuned in traffic.ini. [verified]
- Vehicles show brake lights when braking or stopped. [untested]
- Vehicles use turn indicators at junction turns, on lane changes and when entering or leaving buildings. [untested]
- Traffic keeps right, and only moves into the right lane when it is clearly free. [untested]
- Vehicles pick their turn lane closer to the junction, but no closer than their braking distance plus about 40 m. [untested]
- Vehicles overtake slow or stopped vehicles on multi-lane roads. [untested]
- Lane changes and pull-outs are longer and smoother: 25 to 100 m depending on speed. [untested]
- Merging vehicles wait at the start of the merge until there is a gap. Main-road traffic moves over for them when it is safe. [untested]
- Vehicles are sent home automatically if they have had no route, or have not moved on the road, for 3 minutes. Vehicles queueing at a full building get 6 minutes. The time limit is set with $STUCK_VEHICLE_SECONDS, and 0 turns it off. [tonight]
- Roads being upgraded stay open as a slow last resort: about 10 km/h for vehicles and half walking speed for pedestrians. Roads under new construction stay closed. [untested]
- Traffic going straight on picks the less crowded lane, based on live congestion in each lane. [tonight]
- As a last resort, a vehicle that has waited 30 seconds at a junction with a clear road ahead now takes the junction slots it needs. It takes them only from a stopped vehicle that is stuck behind other traffic, and that vehicle asks again when it gets there. This never happens at a red or amber light. [tonight]

## Junctions, lanes & road markings

### Fixes
- Two roads joined end to end no longer turn into a paved intersection. This includes bent or offset joins and joins with different lane counts. [verified]
- Using the one-way tool across a join from 2 lanes to 4 lanes no longer turns it into an intersection. [verified]
- Fixed missing turns across oncoming lanes, and turn arrows on the wrong lane, where the two directions of a road have different lane counts. This also caused some "no route" cases for offices. [untested]
- A junction with one bad arm, turn or marking keeps working. Only the faulty part is dropped. [untested]
- Side roads joining a wide road at a shallow angle no longer pave a huge slab. Footpaths continue where the road width changes, and wide-to-narrow joins keep their straight lanes. [untested]
- Each turn keeps its identity when a lane direction is flipped. Signals and restrictions no longer end up pointing at the wrong turn. [untested]
- Junctions on bridges no longer let traffic cross the oncoming lanes. Before, trucks crossed the whole bridge to reach an off-ramp. [untested]
- Merge arrows now sit where the ramp lane clears the main road, and they point the right way. One on-ramp no longer erases the main road's direction arrows. Edge lines stay open along the whole merge. [untested]
- The outer lane before a split now allows both straight on and the exit. [untested]
- At a side junction on a multi-lane road (any T-junction, such as a roundabout entry), the outer lane keeps straight on instead of becoming turn-only. Lane arrows follow. [tonight]

### Changes
- Traffic lights adapt to traffic. Green lasts at least 7 s and is extended while vehicles keep arriving, up to 45 s. It ends early after a gap when another approach is waiting, and empty phases are skipped. Setting SIGNAL_MODE FIXED in traffic.ini restores the old fixed cycle. [untested]
- A lane that ends gets a merge arrow towards the neighbouring lane, or a lane-end line. A lane that nothing feeds into gets a start arrow. [untested]
- Repeated direction arrows are left out within 100 m of a turn, merge or start arrow, to reduce arrow clutter. [untested]

## Road & bridge building (ramps, merges, splits, snapping)

### Fixes
- A second road can now join a bridge end that already has a road. The "Crossing not allowed" error no longer appears. [verified]
- Parallel snapping works again on ground roads, for example beside a roundabout and when splitting a road. [verified]
- Terrain no longer shows through the deck and approach at mod bridge ends. [verified]
- A road dragged to a building connector now connects even when parallel snapping is on. The building connector always wins. [untested]
- Roads joining a road end with a different lane count also curve in when the drag ends at that road end, including at bridge ends. [untested]
- Starting a new road from the end of a road you just placed no longer fails on the click while the preview shows green. [untested]
- Bridge pillars no longer land on roads passing below. Pillars already standing in a save stay until that bridge piece is rebuilt. [untested]
- Ramps no longer split the bridge they merge into, so its pillars, railings and deck stay as built. Ordinary junctions on bridges still split it. [untested]
- Bridge railings, side walls and edge lines now open only where a ramp merges. The ramp's end piece is trimmed and its outer railing is kept. [untested]
- At ordinary side joins on bridges, the bare deck wedge is no longer left standing inside the main bridge. [untested]
- A bridge ramp started beside a ground road no longer shows a red preview. Roads and road bridges can now parallel-snap to each other, and so can rails and rail bridges. The tool keeps its own height. [untested]
- When one lane of a road already has a ramp, the opposite lane now still shows its attachment dot for a second ramp. [untested]
- Beside large bridges, attachment dots no longer take over from parallel snapping. [untested]
- Normal bridge ramps now qualify as merges. The minimum length is now 15 to 20 m instead of 30 m. [untested]
- The part of a ramp that runs alongside the road or bridge it joins is now built level with it. "Merge lane not level" no longer appears when that road or bridge is itself level. For a ramp built as a bridge or tunnel, the level part is shortened when needed, never below the taper length, so the levelling does not make the ramp steeper than the game's normal slope limit. A ramp too short for that is refused like any other bridge or tunnel that is too steep. [tonight]
- While you drag a bridge beside another bridge, the other bridge now wins over the road underneath it as the parallel-snap target, and the new bridge keeps the deck height instead of dropping to the road. The snap can still drop out during the drag; that is not fixed yet. [tonight]
- Parallel snapping is no longer blocked near joints, such as where two bridge pieces meet. Only a free road end still blocks it, within about 5 m. [tonight]

### Changes
- A road joining a road end with a different lane count now curves in like a native join when the drag starts at that road end. [verified]
- A one-lane one-way road or ramp that joins another road at 45 degrees or less becomes a lane merge or split instead of a full junction. The taper is 15 to 30 m long depending on the main road's speed (15 to 20 m on bridges). Merges get merge arrows and no junction dot, and a ramp that is too short shows "Merge lane too short" in red. [untested]
- Roundabout tools for highways, one-lane roads, ramps and highway bridges now come from config definitions, each with its own icon. [untested]

## Construction offices & worksite logistics

### Fixes
- Construction offices are now assigned to roads that branch off partway along another road. Before, these showed "not assigned to a construction office". [verified]
- Workers and machines now reach those road sites, become residents there, and construction actually progresses. [verified]
- Vehicles leaving an unfinished road site no longer get stuck or flood the log with errors. [verified]
- The construction office yard no longer jams. Departing trucks may pass trucks that are queued to enter the same building. [verified]
- A delivery wagon whose only stop is the site it is standing in no longer blocks the site's service bays. [verified]
- Empty trucks with a single-stop schedule, including trucks with a trailer, now go home. Before, they looped in and out of the worksite every few seconds. [verified]
- Idle machines at a road worksite stay parked until they are needed, instead of being sent home and back again. [verified]
- Vehicles given a new job while standing at a mid-road worksite can now drive out again. [verified]
- Vehicles moving between neighbouring worksites no longer pick a start point across the unfinished road and loop forever. [untested]
- When you select a construction office, the yellow road highlight now continues past mod-built junctions up to the office's radius. [untested]
- Offices, depots and other services now find targets over roads built by the mod. This should fix the intermittent "Road connection with construction office doesn't exist". [untested]

## Fuel & services

### Fixes
- Trucks leaving a depot or office now find fuel stations instead of running dry. In one run, 13 construction trucks had run out of fuel. [verified]
- Trucks parked inside a distribution office or depot can now find fuel and repair stations over roads built by the mod. [untested]

### Changes
- Fuel use now depends on speed. A truck crawling in a queue no longer burns fuel as if it were driving at full speed. [untested]

## Buildings & parsing

### Fixes
- The stock brick factory, coal and iron processing buildings and the rail construction office load fully again. An incomplete crane row now skips only that crane slot instead of rejecting the whole building. [untested]
- Recycling buildings, university_medical and the workshop woodhouse load again. [untested]
- Some vehicles load again, including the DLC3 Russobalt T40, the an2_cargo and the DLC3 horse combine and carriage. [untested]
- A building or vehicle name, or a country label, with a missing quote no longer hangs or crashes the game. Names that span several lines are no longer supported; no stock file uses them. [untested]
- Building models are now loaded only when they are needed, instead of all at once at startup. This avoids high memory use and crashes with large workshop packs. [untested]

## UI & GUI

### Fixes
- Junctions where traffic arrives from only one road no longer show a junction dot. [untested]
- The lane-direction tool no longer leaves a short two-way stub at the junction mouth. [untested]

### Changes
- The lane-direction tool can be dragged through junctions, T-junctions and road-type changes. It shows a preview of the new arrows. [untested]
- While you place a road, the cost tooltip shows whether the join will be "Splitting road", "Merging road" or "Building junction". [untested]

## Stability, crashes & loading

### Fixes
- Loading a save no longer floods the log with about 60 road errors. [verified]
- Fixed graphics exceptions at load caused by the mod's flag, flagpole and fence textures. [verified]
- Built roads are no longer silently left out of the traffic network. Failures are retried, roads with an unknown type fall back to standard asphalt or footpath, and faulty junctions keep working with fewer connections. [untested]
- Construction phases without crane slots no longer cause an invalid read. [untested]
- A failed bridge-pillar lookup, which is most likely after a game update, no longer disables all of the mod's utility builders. [untested]

## Performance

### Fixes
- The loading log no longer drops the game to about 1 fps in long sessions. The game now runs at about 85 fps in the same situation. [verified]

## Other

### Changes
- An unknown setting in traffic.ini is skipped with a warning instead of rejecting the whole file. [untested]

items.title: Large stable release.
items.summary:
Date: 2026-09-29 13:07 UTC
Versions: Core 0.2.1 · WorldOverhaulLoader.dll 0.2.1.0 · workshopManager.dll 0.2.1.0 · Infrastructure 0.2.1 · WorldOverhaul.dll 0.2.1.0 · Injector 0.2.1 · Content revision release-20260929T130702Z-8c9d6744

This is a large update that will hopefully be the last big update before the mod can go public. The idea is to have a week or two of testing now with hotfixes while I change some architectural stuff around to make the mod more open for third party DLL's to run on it. 

New features:
- The launcher will require one more manual installation, after that it will automatically update
- Bridges can now be merged and split freely while using the ramps
- Water and sewage switches are back and functional
- Added extensive performerance diagnostics to catch slowdowns and being able to fix them later
- A ton of new models and content, including skins 

Bug fixes:
Fixed crashes when workshop buildings use unrecognized characters
Fixed save-loading crashes involving Workshop buildings and underground meshes.
Fixed construction offices failing to find reachable construction projects.
Fixed vehicles in offices and parking buildings failing to find reachable fuel stations or horse feeders.
Fixed pedestrian connections and reachability, including residents stuck at building entrances, on tram roads, or while crossing roads.
Fixed progressive slowdowns when building and changing connections.
Restored parallel rail snapping from track ends and corrected parallel track spacing.
Fixed water failing to reach connected treatment plants.
Fixed unnecessary vehicle parsing errors from empty optional $LIGHT_BLINKER entries.
Reclassified recoverable routing and deferred-refresh messages as warnings.
Fixed unnecessary launcher restart/update prompts for the same version.

Please playtest, and don't forget to share good looking screenshots in the showoff channel!

items.title: WorldOverhaul pre-alpha testing begins
items.summary:
Welcome to the WorldOverhaul pre-alpha test phase! We are opening up this early build to test the launcher, components and their integration with Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic.

This is an unfinished development build. Many functions may not work properly yet, some features are incomplete, and you may encounter crashes, visual issues or unexpected behaviour. Updates may change how components and settings work. Please use a separate test installation and back up any saves you care about.

If something goes wrong, use the launcher's Bug report page. Tell us what happened, what you expected, and how to reproduce the issue. Screenshots and the included game logs help us investigate.

Thank you for helping us test WorldOverhaul and shape its development!
